name: Medius
summary: Medius sells AP automation for mid-sized and larger finance teams in two packages, AP Essentials and AP 360, both by quote with no published price. Payment is part of the invoice-to-pay flow, with ACH, electronic checks and virtual card in the US and SEPA, BACS, CHAPS and wires in Europe.

facts.text: Medius says its Capture module uses AI to extract invoice data automatically and archives invoices for later audit.
Medius says AI suggests coding and approvers and routes invoices dynamically.
The payments page lists ACH, electronic print checks and virtual card in the US, and SEPA, BACS, CHAPS, BankGiro and wire in Europe.
Medius says it returns a monthly vested share of virtual card spend to the customer.
Medius's pricing page shows two packages, AP Essentials and AP 360, and sends buyers to sales for a quote.

hiddenCosts: Additional Medius solutions can be added to either package at extra cost, with no amounts published.
